item.description:
A small UX pass plus the foundations that make the upcoming v0.3.0 cleanup pass possible.

  • “Reset sound selections” button in Settings restores each event’s per-sound pick to the default that would have been chosen on a fresh install. Master “Play sound effects” toggle is untouched — disabling everything is preserved across reset. The button greys out when the master toggle is off, matching the per-row behavior.
  • Filter controls now sit on the trailing edge of the toolbar. Previously the funnel and ellipsis bunched on the left next to the month picker; they now align with the Total Cost column header on the right, which is the standard Mac toolbar shape (navigation on the left, contextual actions on the right).
  • Under the hood: tests now run in CI on every PR and push to main, with code coverage rendered into the workflow run page. 238 tests, ~3-min CI job. v0.2.7 baseline coverage is 65.99% on the macos-26 runner; the upcoming code-quality pass will work down the gap list this surfaces.
